area: Auth, scope and secrets: the signed-in tenant (one sign-in, kept in server memory, used by every page's tenant reads)
title: Wave 10: sign in once; the verified sign-in is kept in memory for the person and browser, for reads only, with idle and hard expiry

coverage.how: tests/test_tenant_session.py maps each acceptance item of the spec (expert to Simple without re-entering, expiry, sign-out, secret canaries, another browser or person, writes still gated, sample tenant unaffected) to a test; tests/test_tenant_session_browser.py drives the expert page and Simple mode in headless Chrome

checks.what: After Authenticate, an assessment that sends no sign-in (Simple mode) signs in with the remembered tenant; without one it is refused before any client is built
30 minutes idle and 8 hours hard expiry; the secret is dropped when it ends and the page is told in words; repeating the same sign-in never extends the hard limit
Sign out of tenant, signing out of the app, a failed sign-in and another tenant's sign-in all forget it
Another browser, a forged handle, another team account with the same grants, and a revoked grant get nothing
Writes never use it: with write mode on and every gate passed, a deploy without its own sign-in is refused in words and builds no client; no tenant write route is ruled read
A canary secret is in no response, cookie, stdout or stderr line, audit entry or file after sign-in, reads, status and sign-out
The sample tenant is never kept and still answers reads while it is in use

findings.title: Switching from the expert page to Simple mode after Authenticate ended in an error: the server forgot the sign-in and Simple mode had no credentials
findings.fix: The verified sign-in is kept in server memory for the person and browser (tenant_session); tenant reads fall back to it; Simple mode adopts it or the guide's saved profile
